title: Hazel dispatch ticket
description: The artifact that crosses from the knowledge base to a product repository. Generated from an approved decision; carries the direction, the reasoning, and the evidence so the receiving engineer needs no other context.

decision_id.description: The approved decision this ticket carries. A ticket cannot exist without one.

target.description: Taken from the decision's routing. One ticket per routing entry; a decision affecting three repos produces three tickets sharing a decision_id.

owner.description: Repository owner at time of dispatch. Optional; resolved from repo ownership if absent.

direction.description: What must change, stated as behaviour. Never an implementation instruction — the receiving engineer writes the spec, not this ticket.

reasoning.description: Why. Carried forward so the engineer does not have to reconstruct intent from the decision statement alone.

acceptance_criteria.description: Observable conditions that make this ticket done. Each should be checkable without reading the code.

evidence.description: Carried unchanged from the decision so provenance survives the repository boundary.

authorized_by.description: The same librarian approval that confirmed the decision. Dispatch is not a second gate.

status.description: draft before dispatch; spec_changed once the receiving engineer has amended the spec; done when the implementing PR merges.

dispatched_to.description: Where the ticket landed — issue URL or file path in the target repo. Absent while status is draft.

related_questions.description: Open questions the receiving engineer should be aware of. Does not block the ticket.
